title: Gemma landmarks, verified, and routes to kitchen and restroom
note: Gemma 4 E4B labelled 249 walkthrough frames (468 sightings). Strict clustering plus a second Gemma pass that checks each crop cut the noise to 18 landmarks; approach points are restricted to floor reachable from the entrance. The K1 then walks to both demo destinations in the twin.
say: Gemma found the kitchen, the restrooms, the bar and 15 other landmarks by itself, and double-checked its own work.
